Author: tangent-thorn
Name: Drydock
Punchline: Fleet status, return timers, levelling progress, salvage income and restock needs for every submarine across your characters.
Description:
Fleet status, return timers, levelling progress, salvage income and restock needs for every submarine across your characters.

Requires AutoRetainer (custom repo: https://love.puni.sh/ment.json) and Submarine Tracker. Allagan Tools and CashFlow add salvage and gil tracking.
CommandHelp: /drydock opens the dashboard. Subcommands: setup, refresh, config.
